prompt: Create a polished cohesive Roblox game UI asset sheet on a perfectly uniform bright magenta #FF00FF background. Landscape canvas with a precisely organized 4-column by 4-row grid of 16 isolated assets, one asset per cell, ample magenta separation, no overlaps. Row 1: rounded rectangular START button with play triangle, SHOP button with bag icon, SETTINGS button with gear icon, REWARDS button with gift icon. Row 2: empty rounded square icon-button frame, empty rounded rectangular panel with header strip but no text, horizontal progress bar partly filled cyan, compact pill counter containing gold coin icon and exact text 1250. Row 3: standalone gold coin icon, standalone gift box icon in blue with gold ribbon, standalone blue shopping bag icon, standalone blue gear icon. Row 4: standalone blue house icon, standalone gold star icon, standalone blue shield icon, standalone blue rounded X close icon. All objects front-facing, consistent lighting, same outline weight and coherent cartoon game asset family. Buttons and panels have blue interior fills. Icons have bold simple silhouettes legible at small size. Every pixel outside the assets must be the same flat #FF00FF magenta. No checkerboard, no transparency simulation, no environmental background, no labels outside the requested buttons and counter, no watermark, no connecting elements, no ambient shadows or glow outside silhouettes. Do not use magenta anywhere inside the assets. This is an export-ready asset sheet, not a screenshot or full menu.
